{"id":1986778801,"question_id":3019,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 4 weeks","timestamp":1777013711,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1986778801/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Furthest Point From Origin","memory":"9.2 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int furthestDistanceFromOrigin(string moves) {\n        int left = 0 , right = 0;\n\n        for(auto ch : moves)\n        {\n            if(ch == 'L') \n            {\n                left++;\n                right--;\n            }\n            else if(ch == 'R') \n            {\n                right++;\n                left--;\n            }\n            else \n            {\n                left++;\n                right++;\n            }\n        }\n        return max(left , right);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"furthest-point-from-origin","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1936}
